primary_research_question: Algorithmic/methodological: exact kernel ridge regression on regular-grid climate fields via circulant embedding (Dietrich-Newsam / Wood-Chan) and FFT spectral shrinkage - O(N log N) train/predict, O(N) memory, no explicit N-by-N Gram matrix - with leakage-free evaluation, kernel-consistent off-grid Nino3.4 functional prediction, and resource accounting (wall-clock, peak RSS, flops, bytes; accuracy-per-flop, accuracy-per-byte) as first-class axes.
substrate: AI-for-climate: sea-surface temperature (SST) anomaly fields; tasks: masked-field reconstruction (gap-filling) and Nino3.4 (ENSO) index regression. Climate is the experimental substrate, not the claimed contribution.

source_of_truth.gate_feedback: hypothesis gate r1 PASS; merged feedback: exactness qualifies as exact-for-embedded-torus / approximate-for-free-boundary; numeric halo/block-CV protocol; matched-flops baselines; pilot-to-production scaling model; reproducible synthetic fallback.
source_of_truth.data_readiness_probe: NOAA PSL Kaplan SST reachable (200) but sst.mon.anom.nc is netCDF-4/HDF5 (magic 0x89HDF), not readable by scipy.io.netcdf_file (classic only); h5py/xarray not in allowed stack. THREDDS DAP2 .ascii => 400; IRIDL .ascii => auth-redirect page. Real-data route unreliable under allowed stack; synthetic-from-physics fallback likely fires, with explicit [simulated] markers.
source_of_truth.constraints: CPU-only; numpy/scipy/scikit-learn/matplotlib only; 12 cores; ~7 GB RAM; total experiment wall-clock <= 90 min; datasets < 2 GB.

arms.name: 32x32 pilot correctness gate
arms.goal: Validate the FFT-KRR (circulant-embedded spectral shrinkage) solver against a dense exact N x N KRR solve. Pass threshold (pre-committed): |alpha_fft - alpha_dense|_inf < 1e-6 * max|alpha_dense| and |pred_fft - pred_dense|_inf < 1e-6 on 10 random holdout cells, for Matern(3/2) and squared-exponential kernels at 32x32 = 1024 cells, ridge lambda = 1e-3. Also produce padding-size sweep: embedding boundary error vs padding fraction {0.5, 1, 2}x, demonstrating error decay.

arms.name: Exact spectral masked-field reconstruction (masks as prediction targets)
arms.goal: Train FFT-KRR on complete fields; impute masked held-out pixels (10/30/50% random-pixel masks; spatial-halo masks with halo width w in {1,2,4}). CV: leave-one-field-out over 48 held-out months (per season) and spatial-block CV (8x4 blocks, leave-block-out). Report RMSE, R2, split-conformal coverage + mean width per mask type/rate, plus resource axes. Optimism arm: compare identical models under random point-wise splits vs block/halo splits (quantifies G3 leakage optimism).
arms.inputs: Kaplan SST v2 (72x36) if stdlib-readable data source is found; else synthetic-from-physics (same lat/lon grid) with [simulated] markers
arms.budget_est: ~8 min (48 LOFO fits x 2 kernels x 3 pads + halo/block CV folds)

arms.name: FFT-preconditioned CG with masked training inputs
arms.goal: Train with 10/30/50% masked inputs via FFT-preconditioned conjugate gradient on the observed-subset system; report iterations, wall-clock, peak RSS, final RMSE vs T1a (same test masks). No claim of one-shot exactness in the masked regime; convergence tol 1e-8, max 2000 iters.

arms.name: Nino3.4 index regression (kernel-consistent functional prediction)
arms.goal: Predict monthly Nino3.4 index = area-weighted mean SST anomaly over 5N-5S, 120-170W (Trenberth 1997) as kernel-consistent linear functional of the fitted field via trigonometric interpolation of stationary cross-covariances (O(N log N), no grid resampling). 5-fold temporal-block CV (blocks of 60 months). Inputs: full fields and T1a-reconstructed fields. Zero-model ablation: predict index from unmasked truth via the same interpolation path to separate interpolation error from KRR error.

arms.name: scikit-learn baselines, commensurable via cost sweeps
arms.goal: Baselines on the same tasks: exact KernelRidge on subsamples n in {2k, 5k, 10k}; Nystrom landmarks {500, 2k, 5k, 10k}; Random Fourier Features {500, 2k, 5k, 10k} (kernels: Matern(3/2), squared-exponential via RBF). Matched-flops/matched-bytes variant (same estimated op count as one FFT-KRR fit) for accuracy-per-flop and accuracy-per-byte comparison. Resource axes: wall-clock, peak RSS (GB), estimated flops and bytes per fit.
arms.inputs: same data as T1a (downsampled to fitted budget)
arms.budget_est: ~15 min (n=10k dense solve ~3-5 min; sweeps dominate)

arms.name: Pilot-to-production scaling model
arms.goal: Measure wall-clock/memory for FFT-KRR at grids 32x32 (1024), 72x36 (2592), 144x72 (10368), and extrapolate to 0.25-degree global (~1.04M cells) with the O(N log N)/O(N) model vs the 7 GB cap (embedding-matrix storage threshold). Report measured vs predicted.
arms.inputs: synthetic fields at each grid size

primary.name: Kaplan SST v2 monthly anomalies
primary.license_note: NOAA PSL public domain distribution; acknowledgment of PSL requested for publications
primary.readability: netCDF-4/HDF5 (magic 0x89HDF) - NOT readable by scipy.io.netcdf_file; no h5py/xarray in stack. Attempt stdlib-readable route: THREDDS DAP2 .ascii with corrected constraint syntax; if unavailable, fallback fires.

fallback.name: synthetic-from-physics SST-anomaly-like fields
fallback.generator: Circulant-embedded Matern(3/2 or 5/2) stationary Gaussian random field on the 72x36 lat/lon grid with latitude-scaling amplitude, Kaplan-like EOF structure (dominant spatial modes with low-frequency temporal coefficients), monthly sampling over 1950-2023 (888 fields), optional seasonal cycle; seed fixed (20260831); parameterization and seed recorded in the generator script and every artifact marker.
fallback.markers: Every artifact JSON and CSV from fallback data carries [simulated] in dataset.origin; the paper states the fallback explicitly.

cv_design.t1: leave-one-field-out over 48 held-out months (12 per season x 4 seasons) + spatial-block CV (8x4 blocks, leave-block-out)
cv_design.t1_masks: random-pixel masks 10/30/50%; spatial-halo masks with halo width w in {1,2,4} separating test pixels from training support (G3 leakage closure)
cv_design.t2: 5-fold temporal-block CV (block = 60 consecutive months) for the index regression; no random point splits
cv_design.optimism: identical model trained under random point-wise split vs block/halo split; report both RMSEs and the gap (G3 measurement)

baselines.matched_cost: run each baseline at the estimated flops/bytes of one FFT-KRR fit for the accuracy-per-flop / accuracy-per-byte frontier

hyperparameters.selection: fixed validation set per arm (block-respecting); report sensitivity, no marginal-likelihood claims
hyperparameters.conditioning: condition-number estimate of the embedded spectral diagonal reported per experiment

pilot_gate.pass: |alpha_fft - alpha_dense|_inf < 1e-6 * max|alpha_dense| AND |pred_fft - pred_dense|_inf < 1e-6 on 10 holdout cells, kernels Matern(3/2) + RBF, lambda 1e-3
pilot_gate.embedding_error_sweep: padding fraction {0.5, 1, 2}x; report boundary-error decay vs padding
pilot_gate.failure_action: pilot blocked => diagnostic artifacts (pilot_gate.json with diffs) committed; stage blocked with concrete reason

scaling_model.formula: train = c1 * N * log2(N) FFTs (2D), memory = c2 * N (plus padded embedding (2N)2), solve = elementwise
